name: s81sl_lepnh
structural_change: S81-LEPV (owner 10-18 "remove ties where cheap"): HOST_EN 0 variant of the end-slice link-port leaf s81sl_lep for the three endpoints without the host plane (s_0S / s_0N via dsdv_slice_lepw, s_7S via dsdv_slice_lepe_nh). Same macros, placement, outline and E / W / S faces as s81sl_lep; NO N face: t_host / t_kd / f_host / f_lf / f_ks and l0_st / l1_st are not ports, the THOST / TKD pending registers, host pin flops and f_host / f_ks / f_lf registers are generated out; a HOST / KS frame arriving here is a protocol fault. Replaces 3 x 131 b of tied die pads. HOURLY-S81/LEP 10-19 (after --cts gate 20261018-175853 FAIL clock_rule pin-flop spread TT 128.8 / FF 115.9, GRT 0, timing met): 16 per-region clock roots by 2-D k-means (physical/common_flow/clock_split_km.tcl, OT_CKKM_K 16, proven on s81sl_xr1 128/113 -> 48.6/46.4); io_hold_margin 0.025 (KITS rule 10-18); bench min_count_regex gains its capture group. Same RTL, ports, cycles, SDC. S81-FIX3 10-19 (route s81sl_lepnh-90fc20580 NEEDS_RTL TT -55.92 / FF -7.15, DRC 0): CLASSIFIED -- all 66 TT setup violators are lane-1 TX SRAM rd_out (macro clk->q 421 ps TT) -> WREG forward mux AO21 -> ~265 ps buffered wire across the lane-0 column -> lo1_d output pin flop (distance from macro to pin face; not fanout, not logic depth, not IO: input/output slack +356/+320); FF hold -7.15 = WREG wd_q -> SRAM wd_in (macro clock 5 CTS delay buffers later than the wd_q leaf). Fix: RTL TXRP 1 = one read pipeline register beside the SRAM column (odr; lo_v / lo_d +1 edge, credit round trip ~8 <= CRED 8, full rate); hold_margin 0.03 -> 0.045 for the macro write pins; io_hold_margin 0.025 -> 0.03 (KITS rule); reset_landing 2 stages (route probe rst_n capture 195 ps; ROOT-RST, reset release +2). Outline, macros, pins unchanged. S81-SLICE3-LEP 10-19 (lep 90fc20580 route TT -44.76 and d77e88ef6 regate FAIL: TT pin-flop spread 84.8 > 80, real reg->reg -58.97 ps rpc -> 8:1 head mux -> h0 decode -> 514-bit fh_d enable; lepnh 90fc20580 TT -55.92 and fx3 regate FAIL spread 90.1): STRUCTURAL successor. RTL 23fd77ae5: TXRP 1 (TX read pipeline register beside each SRAM column, +1 lo edge) + RXSA 1 (18 grouped RX landing slices with kept one-hot enables / head pointer / pop copies, show-ahead head register, kind pre-decoded per row, registered one-hot select copies rid 35 / fh_d 17 / fk_d 2 loaded from the next state: 0 edges). Floorplan: 10 SRAM on the 43.2 lattice (x 43.2 / 259.2 columns, rows at 86.4 pitch), every gap >= 41.9 um, full-width standard rows between every macro row (no islands, PDN-connected), clock entry centred on the S face, regional km16 roots, pin_reg_split, reset_landing 2, io_hold_margin 0.03.

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered (RTL-BUILD-S81): ro lands in pin flops (rov/roq), ri / lo_v / lo_d / li_r / rxv / fault leave flops, li handshake + data land in hq / dq flops, sl_f / l*_f land in slq / lfq; recipe pin_regs would add an unpriced stage.

job.purpose: S81-LEPV: host-less end-slice link-port leaf (HOST_EN 0, s_0S / s_0N / s_7S) to closure (TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0 + native audit).

fill_reason.pin_bound: Pin-bound: W ~2,310 lane lo/li pins, E 2,208 ring ro/ri; 475.2 um faces give 4.86/um (<= 6/um); fill = (10 SRAM 51776 + std ~9.2k) / 225815 = 27%: the outline is set by the W/E pin faces and the 43.2-lattice macro columns with >= 20-um channels, not by std-cell area (SAFE item 6 util waived: pin/lattice-bound).
